caption: The drawing depicts a single jug, centrally positioned on a plain, light beige background. The jug is cylindrical with a rounded body that tapers slightly towards the base, and it has a narrow neck with a small circular opening at the top. Attached to the neck, extending partway down the body, is a single strap handle featuring an oval-shaped hole near its top. The jug's surface is decorated with a textured pattern resembling irregular, wavy vertical lines in dark blue or black. The base color of the jug is a mix of olive green and earthy brown, with some lighter and darker patches suggesting variations in glaze or surface wear. The shadows and highlights indicate a light source coming from the left. Near the lower right corner of the background, the name “Annie B. Johnston” is inscribed in small, neat handwriting.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
